notes.title: Patch Notes 1.06
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Disintegration’s multiplayer modes. Today we shut down our servers and removed the multiplayer modes from the game. Multiplayer-specific achievements have been updated and can now be obtained in the single-player campaign. Complete patch notes are below.

[b]Patch Notes 1.06[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer mode and all multiplayer-related features have been removed 
[*]4 Multiplayer Achievements/Trophies have been replaced with Campaign Achievements/Trophies 
[list]
[*] If a player has already unlocked an MP Achievement/Trophy, they will not see the updated Campaign Achievement/Trophy for that previously unlocked achievement 
[/list]
[*] Three new languages have been added 
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese 
[*] Traditional Chinese  
[*] Korean 
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Store button has been removed from game
[*] Players should retain any coins they already had in inventory to purchase items using in-game currency.
[*] Some crashes were fixed throughout the campaign
[*] PC only: PC candidate fix for Particle System crashes.
[/list]

More information here: https://www.disintegrationgame.com/an-update-on-disintegration-multiplayer/

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.02
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋 

We at V1 Interactive & Private Divison hope you all staying healthy and safe during these crazy times. 

We also hope that you all are excited as we are for the upcoming play for free weekend starting tomorrow! 

I just wanted to inform you all that we are issuing out a new patch for Steam. 

Here are the highlights. 

Highlights: 👇 
This patch for Steam includes bug fixes and optimizations that the team has been working on. We really value and listen to the feedback that you all have given us, and many of the items being addressed in this patch are here because of your feedback.
What is being addressed in this patch: 
● Tuned gravcycles in campaign and multiplayer to feel faster and more responsive
● Fixed a bug that caused ties in Retrieval matches when the score is 3 to 3, and the last attacking team captures their cores faster overall. This situation will now result in a win for the Attackers in Round 2.
● Updated VFX 
○ Minor tuning to Warrior Shotguns firing FX 
○ Merc mine deploy radius and detection FX
○ Muzzle FX updates on Warrior, Muertos & Business 
○ Updated Mortar Strike and Sticky Grenade detonation FX 
○ Updated rocket explosion FX 
● Added UI elements and functionality to allow players to return to matchmaking more quickly 
● Added functionality that no longer closes matchmaking when players try to use console platform dashboard features 
● Removed redundant ‘Save Options’ prompt when player makes adjustments in the Options menu 
● Fixed initial splash screen input prompt (on start-up) to more accurately respond to player input 

Thank you again We value the feedback that you all have given us. 🙏


For more info on the upcoming play for free weekend tomorrow. Please click here! 
👇
[url=bit.ly/2DcOtdO]PLAY FOR FREE WEEKEND[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.01
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋  
I hope you all are doing well and staying healthy during these crazy times. We have just issued out patch 1.01 today on Steam. 

Here are the highlights.  

Highlights: 👇  
This patch for Steam includes bug fixes and optimizations that the team has been working on over the past few weeks. We have a lot more planned in the near future and we continue to listen to feedback from the community.  We will be sharing more information regarding that as soon as it is available! 
 
Bug Fixes 
Stability: 
- Stability optimization in multiplayer: Fixed some crashes involving Gravcycle deaths.  
- Performance optimizations in increasing the overall performance of the map Lesney Bay. 
- Stability optimization for Windows 7: Fixed a crash that prevented Windows 7 users from launching the title. 
 
Text/UI: 
- Multiple Localization fixes: Updated text strings as well as UI layout adjustments. 
- We fixed an issue that caused some medals to become distorted when acquired. 
- We fixed an issue that blocked currency rewards from showing in the challenge’s menu. 
- We fixed an issue that caused inverted cameras to return to default settings in the Garage. 

Gameplay​: 
- We fixed an issue that associated an incorrect challenge with Tech Noir. (Defeat 5 enemy Gravcycles within a timed window has been replaced with needing to defeat 5 enemy Gravcycles without respawning) 
- We fixed an issue that caused the Cinematic V banner to unlock in place of Cinematic 1’s banner. 
- We fixed an issue that caused players to be removed from gameplay during Steam maintenance. 
  
Please keep in mind that we are continuing to work on addressing other bugs that are being reported from the community, we really do value the feedback that you all have given us. 🙏
